svg.text: Kit A, step 2 of 4: four wires from the board
The four columns nearest the board become the shared wires: 14 is 3.3 V, 15 is ground, 16 is SDA, 17 is SCL. Red P1.14 to 14, black P1.15 to 15, blue P1.26 to 16, yellow P1.28 to 17.
Each shared column is one wire inside the breadboard, five holes long. The board's wire, the sensor's wire and the screen's wire will each use one hole of it.
Say it out loud: red leaves 14 and arrives at column 14. Black leaves 15 and arrives at 15. Blue leaves 26 and arrives at 16. Yellow leaves 28 and arrives at 17.
board turned so P1 is its top
